Privacy and data ownership

Keep the public framework separate from private business information.

Using this framework does not require publishing customer data, financial records, employee information, credentials, business plans, interview answers, or completed assessments.

Before sharing information

  • Determine whether the AI processes information locally or through an external provider.
  • Review the provider's current retention, training, access, and deletion settings.
  • Confirm that the business is authorized to use each document and data element.
  • Remove or mask details that are not necessary for the current question.
  • Store approved checkpoints and assessments in access-controlled systems.

Hosted is not fully local

A private hosted workspace may provide useful controls, but information is still processed under the provider's terms. Fully local operation also requires local document extraction, embeddings, retrieval, storage, logging, backups, and appropriate network controls.

Minimum necessary

Use the least amount of information needed for a useful answer. Prefer summaries, ranges, redaction, synthetic examples, and local processing when they preserve analytical value.

About visits to this website

This site has no assessment form or business-data backend, and it adds no analytics script. Search and copy controls run in your browser. The hosting provider may process connection details such as your IP address and set security cookies. Information you enter into a separate AI chat tool is handled under that provider's terms and settings.

Report a security concern

Please use GitHub private vulnerability reporting for a security concern. Do not put private business information or exploit details in a public issue.
